objectives.statement: Distinguish deontic modal meaning from epistemic modal meaning in common Norwegian modal verbs.
Select må, kan, skal, vil, and bør to express obligation, permission, intention, probability, and advice.
Use jo, vel, nok, and da to adjust certainty, shared assumption, probability, and emphasis.
Avoid overloading one sentence with too many modal and stance markers.

notes: High-risk meaning topic. Must contrast deontic obligation/permission/intention with epistemic inference/probability/reported expectation, especially må, skal, kan, vil, bør plus stance particles. Include the strength difference between jo, vel, nok, and limited emphatic da.
